name: A Pious Life increases Horusath Blast and Rapture damage by 15% (#886)
contract: A Pious Life 570027 is family 33, Attributes 192 (SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE), EquippedItemClass -1, no Stances, so it self-applies on learn. Its single effect is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE) and EffectSpellClassMask word1 524352 (bits 0x40 and 0x80000), EffectBasePoints 14 + DieSides 1 = 15. Horusath Blast 500154 carries SpellFamilyFlags word1 64 (0x40); Rapture 806477 carries word1 524288 (0x80000). Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone applies modOwner->ApplySpellMod(id, SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, tmpDamage) unconditionally at the end of the function, regardless of any spell_bonus_data coefficient; this is not "no server-side implementation", the +15% already applies to both named spells. spell_damage_done queries SpellDamageBonusDone directly with a fixed base of 1000 and no cast submitted.
